scope: Independent, read-only review of Dr. Social model-sheet candidate v4 against the approved v2 matrix, the user request, and the v3 review findings. Inspect late-19th-century London costume cues across views; face, palette, scale and style continuity; both shoulder-to-hand anatomical chains and grips in the signature action; whether the cane arm is clearly in front of the torso instead of emerging behind the coat; distinction between blunt walking cane and separate rapier; boomerang silhouette versus violet trails; all labeled equipment silhouettes and reference-only boundary; ruler, baseline, card readability and crop integrity. The three v3 findings to verify are cane-arm attachment, boomerang/effects separation, and explicit source-game inventory boundary. The producer checklist is maintained as a separate record; this independent scope is anchored to the candidate image, approved matrix, project docs and source references.

artifacts.role: previous candidate and direct comparison point
project inventory and character identity authority
weapon terminology discrepancy and adaptation boundary

reviewer_constraints: Read-only independent reviewer; do not edit, replace or promote any file.
Assess the exact candidate hash and compare against the supplied v2 and v3 references; stale files block review.
Report evidence-based defects, risks and opportunities separately, with at most three revision priorities.
Do not claim AAA, sprite, moveset, animation, SMS conversion, ROM or delivery approval.
The source-game equipment panel is reference-only and inventory wording remains open; do not treat it as approval of the fan-game moveset.
